patterns.label: be + wearing
patterns.note: he's = he is / she's = she is / I'm = I am

patterns.label: Is he / Is she wearing...?
examples: Is he wearing glasses? Yes, he is.
Is she wearing a hat? No, she isn't.
Are you wearing a coat? Yes, I am. No, I'm not.

patterns.label: colour + clothing
patterns.note: The colour comes BEFORE the clothing word.

easy.why: He, she and it take is.

core.why: I takes am, never is or are.
Questions about he start with Is when we use wearing.

core.sentence: Is she wearing a hat? Yes, she ___.
core.why: The short answer repeats is: Yes, she is.
Pants is plural, so we do not use a, and the colour has no -s.

core.sentence: Are you wearing a coat? No, I ___ not.
core.why: The answer to Are you...? is I am or I'm not.

challenging.sentence: Clare and Sun Mi ___ wearing hats.
challenging.why: Two people make a plural subject, so use are.
In a negative sentence with a plural noun we use any, not a or some.

challenging.sentence: ___ you wearing your new T-shirt? Yes, I am.
challenging.why: You takes are, and the answer Yes, I am confirms it.
In English the colour comes before the clothing word.

challenging.sentence: Is that your new sweatshirt? No, it ___. It's Alex's.
challenging.why: It takes is, so the negative is isn't.
Neither of them is singular in careful English, so use is.

easy.text: People wear hats to look good. They wear hats for other reasons, too. In Siberia it is very cold. People wear fur hats. Fur hats are very warm. In Cuba it is hot and sunny. People wear Panama hats. A Panama hat is light. It keeps people cool.

questions.q: Why do people wear fur hats in Siberia?
What does a Panama hat do?

core.text: People wear hats to look good, and they wear hats for other reasons too. Siberia is in Russia. It is very cold there, so people wear fur hats. Fur hats are very warm. Cuba is hot and sunny. People there wear special hats called Panama hats. The Panama hat is light. It protects the head from the sun, and it keeps people cool. In Vietnam many people wear a non la hat. It is wide and it keeps people dry in the rain.

questions.q: Where do people wear Panama hats?
Why do people in Vietnam wear non la hats?

challenging.text: People wear hats to look good, and they wear hats for other reasons too. Siberia is in the north of Russia, where winter is long and very cold. People there wear fur hats, because fur is very warm and it stops the cold wind. Cuba is hot and sunny all year, so people wear Panama hats. The Panama hat is light and it has a wide brim. It protects the head from the sun and it keeps people cool, which is important when the temperature is high. In Vietnam many people wear a non la hat. It is wide and light, and it keeps people dry in the heavy rain. So the same idea, a hat, does three different jobs: it keeps you warm, it keeps you cool, and it keeps you dry.
